events.title: Reson8 opens a 0.5B multilingual ASR model built for throughput
events.title_zh: Reson8 开源面向高吞吐的 0.5B 多语种 ASR 模型
events.summary: Reson8 released Rumble 2 Flash, a 0.5-billion-parameter automatic speech recognition model for more than 40 languages. Apache-2.0 weights run through native Transformers and vLLM without custom code. The publisher reports 7,000 times real-time throughput on full batches and 6.96% error on Open ASR multilingual evaluation.
events.summary_en: Reson8 released Rumble 2 Flash, a 0.5-billion-parameter automatic speech recognition model for more than 40 languages. Apache-2.0 weights run through native Transformers and vLLM without custom code. The publisher reports 7,000 times real-time throughput on full batches and 6.96% error on Open ASR multilingual evaluation.
events.summary_zh: Reson8 发布 Rumble 2 Flash：一个支持 40 多种语言的 5 亿参数自动语音识别模型。Apache-2.0 权重可直接通过 Transformers 与 vLLM 运行，无需自定义代码。发布方称满 batch 吞吐达 7,000 倍实时速度，Open ASR 多语评测错误率为 6.96%。
events.why_it_matters: Teams processing large audio backlogs can test a small, permissively licensed model without a custom runtime. Speed and quality results are publisher-reported, so domain accents, noisy calls and tail latency still need local measurement.
events.why_it_matters_en: Teams processing large audio backlogs can test a small, permissively licensed model without a custom runtime. Speed and quality results are publisher-reported, so domain accents, noisy calls and tail latency still need local measurement.
events.why_it_matters_zh: 处理大量音频积压的团队可以用宽松许可的小模型试验，不必维护自定义 runtime。速度与质量仍是发布方自报，领域口音、嘈杂通话和尾延迟需要本地测量。

technical_details.runtime: Transformers and vLLM without custom code
technical_details.publisher_quality: 6.96% Open ASR multilingual error; 6.6% English WER; 7.86% WER on 302 hours of AppTek call-center data versus 7.78% for Nemotron 3.5
technical_details.evidence_limit: Publisher-reported; no independent reproduction in this run
technical_details.time_precision: Official post exposed 2026-11-18 without a publication time

technical_details_zh.运行方式: 原生 Transformers 与 vLLM，无需自定义代码
technical_details_zh.发布方质量: Open ASR 多语错误率 6.96%；英语 WER 6.6%；AppTek 302 小时呼叫中心数据 WER 7.86%，Nemotron 3.5 为 7.78%
technical_details_zh.证据限制: 数据来自发布方，本次未独立复现
technical_details_zh.时间精度: 官方文章只给出 2026-11-18，没有发布时间

events.next_action_zh: 一天内用 2 小时真实多语音频比较 WER、RTFx、P95 延迟、显存和领域词漏识别。
events.next_action_en: Within one day, test two hours of real multilingual audio for WER, RTFx, P95 latency, memory and missed domain terms.

evidence.claim_zh: Rumble 2 Flash 已公开 Apache-2.0 权重，并原生支持 Transformers 与 vLLM。
evidence.claim_en: Rumble 2 Flash has public Apache-2.0 weights with native Transformers and vLLM support.

changes.summary_zh: Rumble 2 Flash 公开权重与原生推理支持
changes.summary_en: Rumble 2 Flash opens its weights and native inference support
